title: Append overhead
statement: p99 append overhead below 1 ms per event.
source: Numbers we are signing up to

title: Run latency budget
statement: Added end-to-end agent run latency below 2%.
source: Numbers we are signing up to
verify: A/B benchmark with and without the collector

title: Default mutability window
statement: Default anchor interval of 10 seconds.
source: Numbers we are signing up to
verify: Default config inspection plus timing test

title: Verification throughput
statement: Verify a 100,000-event run in under 2 seconds, offline.
source: Numbers we are signing up to
verify: Benchmark on a documented reference machine

title: No network at verification
statement: Verification completes with networking disabled.
verify: Test executed in a network-isolated sandbox

title: No credentials at verification
statement: Verification requires no account, token or credential.

title: Long-term verifiability
statement: Evidence remains verifiable years later; algorithms and formats are versioned to allow it.
verify: Format version negotiation test; documented algorithm migration path

title: Node.js 20+
statement: Run on Node.js 20 and later.

title: HSM/KMS support
statement: Operate with a KMS or HSM offering non-exportable keys.
source: Getting started — a KMS or HSM
verify: Integration test against at least one KMS and one HSM

title: OMA version compatibility
statement: Support @open-multi-agent/core 1.21.x.
verify: CI pinned against the supported range

title: MCP transport coverage
statement: Support MCP over stdio and HTTP.

title: Never degrade availability
statement: The collector must never be able to stop or block an agent run.
source: Operations — no audit layer that can take down production
verify: Chaos test: witness outage, disk full, slow witness

title: Durable local queue
statement: Unwitnessed batches survive process restart and are re-submitted.

title: Published threat model
statement: Publish a threat model naming the operator as the adversary.
verify: Document exists and is referenced from the README

title: Detection, not prevention
statement: The stated security goal is detection and attribution, not prevention.
verify: Claims review against documentation and marketing
evidence: stated as the design goal in the threat model

title: No trust in operator or vendor
statement: Verification must not require trusting the operator, host, collector binary, or Splitstick.
verify: Verification from bytes and public keys only

title: One honest witness assumption
statement: Security holds if at least one witness in the configured set is honest; the assumption is documented.

title: Documented exclusions
statement: Publish what is out of scope: actions never attempted, a compromised model, a lying tool, full quorum collusion, a key exfiltrated before first use.
evidence: out-of-scope list, binding in both directions

title: Resist action alteration
statement: Altering recorded arguments, result or approval decision must be detectable.

title: Resist consistent rewrite
statement: Altering an event and repairing its citing digest must be detectable.

title: Resist re-signing history
statement: Re-signing rewritten history with the current key must be detectable under non-exportable custody.

title: Resist truncation
statement: Truncating the record's tail must be detectable.

title: Resist erasure and renumbering
statement: Erasing events and renumbering into a clean stream must be detectable.

title: Resist collector suppression
statement: Stopping or patching the collector and claiming a quiet period must be detectable and attributable.
verify: Kill and patch tests against coverage report

title: Resist policy downgrade
statement: Weakening the anchoring policy before tampering must be visible in the record.

title: Digest pre-image resistance in practice
statement: Salting must prevent brute-force recovery of low-entropy action records from their digests.
verify: Dictionary attack against salted digests fails

title: Operator key never leaves operator
statement: Splitstick must never hold, receive, request or log the operator signing key.
source: Integrity — Splitstick never holds it, sees it, or asks for it

title: Witness sees roots only
statement: Witnesses receive salted roots and nothing else.
verify: Wire capture of all witness traffic

title: Bounded integrity claim
statement: Never claim tamper-proof; claim tamper-evident with attribution.

title: State the forward-secrecy precondition
statement: Any forward-secrecy claim must state its non-exportable key custody precondition in the same place.
source: Integrity — this holds only under non-exportable key custody

title: Remote build attestation (experimental)
statement: Remote attestation of the collector build may ship as experimental; it must not be presented as preventing suppression.

title: Bounty intake and triage
statement: Operate an intake, triage and payment process for the tamper bounty.
verify: Process documented and exercised once before launch

title: Coordinated disclosure window
statement: Disclose within 90 days or on fix, whichever is sooner.

title: Publish unmitigated findings
statement: Publish findings even when no mitigation exists.
source: Bounty terms — including when we have no mitigation
verify: Policy published; audited at each disclosure

title: Zero content egress
statement: No content bytes leave the operator's host under any configuration.
source: Numbers — 0 bytes of content leaving your host
verify: Full egress capture during a representative run

title: No content in the chain
statement: The chain contains no plaintext content.
source: Erasure — no content is ever in the chain
verify: Automated scan of chain files for plaintext

title: Erasure via crypto-shredding
statement: Support a documented erasure procedure satisfying a data-subject deletion request.
verify: Procedure documented and exercised; independent privacy review deferred to a funded release

title: Chain survives erasure
statement: The chain still verifies after content deletion.

title: Minimal retained artefacts
statement: After erasure, only a salted hash and timestamp remain.
source: Erasure — what survives is a salted hash and a timestamp

title: Disclosure minimisation
statement: A disclosure reveals the named event and nothing else about other events' contents.
verify: Pack inspection; sibling hashes carry no recoverable content

title: Disclose the tree-size leak
statement: Document that an inclusion proof reveals the total count of recorded actions.

title: Disclose the cadence leak
statement: Document that anchor cadence leaks activity volume.

title: Operator-controlled retention
statement: Retention is a setting on operator-controlled storage, not a vendor policy.
source: Erasure — policy settings on your storage
